articles.title: Dengue Awareness Campaign 2026
articles.shortDescription: Hijaz Hospital organized a dengue awareness campaign featuring an awareness walk and educational session on prevention and precautionary measures.

content.text: Hijaz Hospital organized a dengue awareness campaign featuring an awareness walk led by Medical Superintendent Dr. Arfan Ishaque and hospital staff, followed by an educational session on dengue symptoms, prevention, and precautionary measures.
Prevention Measures

Staff and community members were briefed on eliminating stagnant water, using mosquito repellents, and recognizing early symptoms such as high fever, headache, and body aches. Early diagnosis and timely treatment remain critical during the monsoon season.
Community awareness is the first line of defense against dengue.

articles.title: Annual Farewell Dinner 2026
articles.shortDescription: Haji Inam Elahi School of Paramedics celebrated graduating students at its Annual Farewell Dinner.

content.text: Hosted by Haji Inam Elahi School of Paramedics, the Annual Farewell Dinner celebrated graduating students and their academic achievements, reflecting the institution's commitment to developing skilled healthcare professionals for Pakistan.
Senior hospital leadership attended the ceremony and encouraged graduates to uphold Hijaz Hospital's values of compassion, service, and professional excellence as they enter the healthcare workforce.

articles.title: International Nurses Day 2026
articles.shortDescription: Hijaz Hospital celebrated International Nurses Day honoring the dedication and compassion of its nursing staff.

content.text: Hijaz Hospital celebrated International Nurses Day to honor the dedication, compassion, and tireless efforts of its nursing staff. The event recognized their vital role in delivering quality healthcare and supporting patients around the clock.
A Culture of Care
Nursing leadership shared messages of appreciation and highlighted how bedside care, patient advocacy, and teamwork sustain Hijaz Hospital's mission of compassionate, accessible healthcare.

articles.title: Visit of Dr. Muhammad Iqbal Hussain
articles.shortDescription: Hijaz Hospital welcomed Dr. Muhammad Iqbal Hussain, a distinguished medical specialist and humanitarian from the United States.

content.text: Hijaz Hospital had the honor of welcoming Dr. Muhammad Iqbal Hussain, who was received by the Chairman and senior executive members. A distinguished medical specialist practicing in the United States, Dr. Hussain is recognized for his lifelong humanitarian services through the International Trust Bait-ul-Maal.

Dr. Hussain maintains a continued association with PKLI, where he provides voluntary medical services annually. His visit reinforced Hijaz Hospital's connections with global humanitarian healthcare networks.

articles.title: Free Medical Camp in Sheikhupura
articles.shortDescription: Hijaz Hospital conducted a free medical camp providing consultations, diagnostics, and medicines to underserved communities.

content.text: Hijaz Hospital's welfare outreach team conducted a free medical camp in Sheikhupura, offering consultations across general medicine, pediatrics, and gynecology. Patients received free medicines and referrals for follow-up care at the hospital.
The camp aligns with Hijaz Hospital's mission to extend compassionate care beyond hospital walls and reach patients who cannot afford treatment.

articles.title: World Kidney Day Awareness Session
articles.shortDescription: Nephrology department led an awareness session on kidney health, early detection, and dialysis support programs.

content.text: On World Kidney Day, Hijaz Hospital's Nephrology department organized an awareness session for patients and attendants on kidney disease prevention, early warning signs, and the importance of regular screening for at-risk individuals.
Dialysis Support at Hijaz

The session highlighted Hijaz Hospital's dialysis care unit and welfare support available for deserving dialysis patients, including stipends and ration assistance through the patient welfare program.

articles.title: Breast Cancer Awareness Month
articles.shortDescription: Pink October campaign with awareness talks, screening guidance, and community education on early detection.

content.text: Throughout Pink October, Hijaz Hospital ran a breast cancer awareness campaign with educational talks for staff, patients, and community members. Gynecology consultants emphasized self-examination, clinical screening, and timely medical consultation.
Information booths in the OPD area provided printed resources and answered questions about screening pathways and support services available at the hospital.

articles.title: ISO 9001 Quality Audit Completed
articles.shortDescription: Hijaz Hospital successfully completed its ISO 9001:2008 quality management audit conducted by TÜV Austria.

content.text: Hijaz Hospital successfully completed its ISO 9001:2008 quality management system audit conducted by TÜV Austria. The audit reviewed clinical processes, documentation, patient safety protocols, and continuous improvement practices across departments.
Maintaining ISO certification reflects Hijaz Hospital's commitment to standardized, accountable healthcare delivery for every patient.

articles.title: Dialysis Unit Capacity Expansion
articles.shortDescription: Hijaz Hospital expanded dialysis unit capacity to serve more patients with free and subsidized haemodialysis.

content.text: Hijaz Hospital expanded its dialysis care unit with additional haemodialysis machines and upgraded monitoring equipment. The expansion increases daily treatment capacity for patients requiring regular dialysis sessions.
A significant proportion of dialysis patients at Hijaz receive treatment through welfare and zakat-supported programs, ensuring financial hardship does not prevent access to life-sustaining care.

articles.title: Understanding Hypertension: A Patient Guide
articles.shortDescription: A longer-form health article on blood pressure management, lifestyle changes, and when to seek care.

content.text: Hypertension, or high blood pressure, is one of the most common conditions treated at Hijaz Hospital's general medicine and cardiology clinics. Left unmanaged, it increases risk of stroke, heart disease, and kidney problems.
Lifestyle Steps

Patients are encouraged to reduce salt intake, maintain regular physical activity, manage stress, and take prescribed medications consistently. Regular follow-up appointments help clinicians adjust treatment as needed.
When to Seek Care
Seek urgent care for severe headache, chest pain, shortness of breath, or vision changes with elevated blood pressure. Routine OPD visits are available for ongoing management and screening.
